newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian grain harvest may hit 80 mln T - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Russian grain harvest may hit 80 mln T - ministry.

text.p: Russia's net grain harvest may reach 80 million tonnes this year, the official Itar-Tass news agency quoted Agriculture Ministry specialists as saying on Wednesday.
The ministry's previous forecast was for grain output of at least 70 million tonnes.
Other government and industry officials have predicted a harvest in the range of 70-75 million tonnes, while First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov forecast 80 million.
Last year's drought-hit output was officially 69.3 million tonnes.
